'''Ronda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] eccentric bioanalyst known for his brilliance. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was aboard a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]]; Ronda was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the crash, but fellow [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] recovered specimens from his latest research at the crash site.
